annotations.title: Add a session to My day or take one out

description: Adds one session to the signed-in person's My day for an event, or takes one out ("add this session to my day", "take the keynote out of my day"). `action` is "add" or "remove", with no default. `session` is either the session id from events_whats_on or event_my_day, or the session's name as the person says it. When the name fits more than one session, the reply is `code` WHICH_SESSION with `choices`, one row per session it fits, and nothing changes. The change shows on the pass page and the event page the next time they load. Needs the person signed in (an unauthenticated call is answered with the sign-in prompt) and `eventIdOrName`.

action.description: REQUIRED. "add" or "remove". There is no default.

eventIdOrName.description: REQUIRED. The event id or the event name as events_list spells it.

session.description: REQUIRED. The session id from events_whats_on or event_my_day, or the session's name as the person says it.

name: event_my_day_change
